question:
Which of the following is correctly matched with respected to the persons and related to their musical instruments?

I. U Srinivas-Mandolin

II. Bismillah Khan - Shehnai
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• U. Srinivas was an Indian mandolin player in the Carnatic musical tradition.
 
• He was widely recognized for his virtuosity and was often referred to as Mandolin Srinivas.
 
• Bismillah Khan was an iconic Indian musician who played the shehnai, a traditional Indian wind instrument.
 
• Bismillah Khan was awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honor, for his contributions to music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **U. Srinivas**

 
 
• Born in 1969, U. Srinivas began playing the mandolin at a very young age and quickly gained recognition for his skill.
 
• He adapted the western instrument mandolin to the Carnatic music tradition and brought it to the forefront of Indian classical music.
 
• He performed at various prestigious venues around the world and collaborated with several international musicians.
 
• His unique style and technical prowess earned him numerous awards and accolades.
 
 
 
• **Bismillah Khan**
 
 
• Born in 1916, Bismillah Khan was a maestro of the shehnai, an instrument traditionally used in North Indian weddings and religious ceremonies.
 
• He elevated the status of the shehnai by bringing it onto the concert stage and showcasing its capabilities in classical music.
 
• Bismillah Khan's performances were known for their spiritual depth and technical brilliance.
 
• In addition to the Bharat Ratna, he received numerous other honors, including the Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
